_doc: SYS-1: the whole system as one declared topology. Every worker, store, queue, index and workflow, with its bindings, is listed here; `python3 -m foundation topology --render` writes each worker's wrangler config, `--check` validates the references, `--drift` compares this file with the live account. state=live means it must exist now; state=planned means the executor is building it (drift reports it as pending, not as a failure). Ids are not secrets; variable values and secrets never appear here (only their names). doctrine/system.json (SYSTEM-1) is GENERATED from this file by `python3 -m foundation topology --emit-system`; edit this file, never that one.

d1.name: ultrastable-org
d1.what: the org's own records: items, claims, gate cards, trust ledger, tick runs

d1.name: ultrastable-ops
d1.what: site analytics, dashboard state, the published transparency snapshot

d1.name: ultrastable-unlearn
d1.what: Unlearn tenant: explorations, coach notes, move weights, beats (instances/unlearn); created 2026-11-21

d1.name: ultrastable-what-works
d1.what: What Works tenant: citation checks, leads, grades, grade changes, reader guesses, beats (instances/what-works); created 2026-11-25

d1.name: ultrastable-spinoffs
d1.what: spinoff app events (spinoffs/schema.sql); the database in the ultrastable account, created 2026-11-20

d1.name: ultrastable-replication-ledger
d1.what: Replication Ledger tenant: discovered findings, machine-read attempts, leads, retraction flags, Crossref checks, standing changes, beats (instances/replication-ledger); created 2026-11-25

kv.name: ultrastable-state
kv.what: worker state for the tick (STATE binding)

r2.name: ultrastable-git
r2.what: bundles and backups of the repositories, and the weekly D1 and KV dumps under backups/ (foundation/backup.py); created 2026-11-19

r2.name: ultrastable-audit
r2.what: AUDIT-CHAIN-1 sealed audit segments, and D1-SNAPSHOT-1 daily copies of ultrastable-org under backups/d1/ (seed/worker/src/d1snapshot.js); created 2026-11-22

queues.name: ultrastable-work
queues.what: work handed from the tick to code agents; the tick worker consumes it

vectorize.name: ultrastable-memory
vectorize.what: the repository's own knowledge for the agents (Q-SYS-VECTOR-KB)

workers.role: heartbeat, executor dispatch, in-Worker code agents, lane, worker gate and handoffs (merge -> deploy -> probe -> close or roll back)
public site, read-only live record, agent surfaces (/mcp, discovery documents), control-plane API /api/v1 and /ops dashboard (reads ORG live)

owner dashboard: e-mailed-code login, task queue, audit log, and a plain-English console agent (read-only until a fresh code; changes go through the audited command path); reached only through the site's OWNER service binding
code agents (Workers AI adapters from doctrine/code-agents.json), probed live
tenant store (US-SPEC-25): per-tenant SQLite Durable Objects with free-plan budgets, vectors and rollups; /health runs a self-test the tick reads

Unlearn tenant app (ultrastable/unlearn): coaching moves for the adult beside a curious child; hourly beat re-learns move weights, measures, opens the next phase when its gates hold, prunes by retention

What Works tenant app (ultrastable/what-works): a living atlas of what works in public policy; hourly beat resolves citations, searches OpenAlex, Europe PMC and Crossref, reads new trials in under a verbatim-quote guard, re-grades every programme and logs each move

spinoff apps on *.ultrastable.app (SPINOFF-1): serves the registry bundle, answers 410 for retired apps; the zone route *.ultrastable.app/* names this script (a zone route, not a custom domain: it is not re-attached by the deployer, so the worker is listed as not public)

Replication Ledger tenant app (ultrastable/replication-ledger): which landmark findings held up when replicated and which failed, across many fields; hourly beat searches OpenAlex for new replications of every finding and for landmark originals not yet held, files an attempt only under a verbatim-quote guard, checks citations at Crossref, recomputes standings and logs each move; reader pages with a guess-first reveal, /changes and /feed.json

_account_split: ACCOUNT-SPLIT-2 (2026-11-15): every id here is in the ultrastable account. The quniverse copies (ultrastable-ultrastable worker and D1, demo-child-ultrastable, the old platform workers) are retired: crons off, kept unmodified as the backup; see deploy/transfer/plan.json.
